---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new mechanic, action, provider, or UX change
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What

Short description of the feature or change.

## Why

What problem does it solve, or what research / gameplay question does it open up? Project Darwin is a research simulation — proposals that change agent behavior, economic dynamics, or observability are especially welcome.

## Proposed approach

If you have a concrete design in mind, describe it. Otherwise, leave open.

For new actions, list which of the five touchpoints would change (`schemas.py`, `actions.py`, `stub.py`, `base.py`, `WorldMap.tsx`). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the checklist.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you rejected them, if any.
